name: manual_8bf6b0
claim: Confirming a large batch of test failures is pre-existing and unrelated to a session's own changes (via a before/after comparison) is a necessary check but not the same as understanding why the failures exist -- stopping there leaves a large, alarming-looking failure count in the record with no actual explanation. Where time allows, finishing the diagnosis by installing missing dependencies one at a time and re-running (watching the count drop) can turn "pre-existing, unrelated, unexplained" into "pre-existing, unrelated, and here is exactly why, with zero project-level fix needed" -- a materially more useful record for whoever encounters the same large failure count next and would otherwise have to re-investigate it from scratch.

decisions.notes: Completes an earlier session's partial diagnosis with the actual root cause, turning an unexplained large failure count into a documented, resolved one.

rationale: Completes an earlier session's partial diagnosis with the actual root cause, turning an unexplained large failure count into a documented, resolved one.
